{{Quote|Fast food chains, that's something the Sector excels in. I'm not kidding! Look at how well one of them is doing. You can get blap-biscuits and pseudo-chudde anywhere, but in the Sector they come up with some dopey holotoon mascot and, ''boom!'', instant success.|Han Solo|<ref name="Corporate">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Pseudo-chudde''' was a popular [[fast food]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]]. It shared its name with the food ingredient [[chudde]].<ref name="Corporate" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pseudo-chudde was mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Corporate" />
